subject: Customer request: complete removal of interaction data and confirmation templates
messages:
From: Emma Hart <emma.hart@globex.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@globex.com
Date: 2027-04-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: complete removal of model interaction data (prompts/outputs/logs)

Hi Laura,

Per our data residency and GDPR obligations we need Redwood to fully remove all raw interaction artifacts for our account GLX-7782 for the date range 2026-10-01 to present. Specifically we require deletion of:
- user prompts and assistant outputs (full prompt/output pairs)
- KV/prefix caches and any in-memory persisted caches that can be serialized
- derived embeddings and search indexes tied to prompt/output blobs
- full request/response logs (access/usage logs that contain content)

Please confirm the exact workflow you will use, expected timeline, and the evidence package we will receive once the delete is executed (audit log entries, deletion receipt, and file manifest). Also confirm that aggregated billing metrics and anonymized telemetry will be retained only in aggregate and not reconstructable to individuals.

We would like the deletion to be executed from your EU data plane (eu-west) and for a signed attestation to be provided. Please let me know if you need any additional account identifiers or proof of authority to process this request.

Thanks,
Emma Hart
Director, Cloud Compliance
Globex Corporation
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Hart <emma.hart@globex.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: complete removal of model interaction data (prompts/outputs/logs)

Hi Emma,

Thanks for the clear request and the account reference (GLX-7782). We can run a complete content-level purge scoped to the EU data plane. High level workflow we'll follow is below — I attached a one-page checklist and a customer-facing confirmation template to this message for your review.

Redwood proposed workflow (summary):
1) Intake & verification: confirm account id, authorized requester and exact date range (we have GLX-7782; confirm written authority).
2) Quarantine: mark the account's data for purge in eu-west so no further writes are retained to content blobs.
3) Purge job: execute region-scoped deletion that removes prompt/output blobs, caches persisted to object storage, and deletes associated embeddings and index shards.
4) Index/metadata sweep: remove pointers and rebuild any global indexes to exclude removed records.
5) Audit & evidence: capture immutable audit log entries (job id + timestamps), produce a deletion manifest, and generate a signed deletion receipt.
6) Follow-up: produce a short attestation letter and provide a downloadable audit bundle (safely redacted where necessary).

What I need from you to proceed:
- Confirm this request in writing and include a primary contact and phone number.
- Confirm final date range: you listed 2026-10-01 to present — is that correct?
- Confirm you want the execution window in the EU (eu-west) and not the US.

Estimated timeline: we can complete intake/verification within 24 business hours after we receive confirmation; purge job typically completes in 48-72 hours for datasets of this size. After execution we'll produce the audit bundle within 24 hours.

Attachments: deletion_flow_checklist.pdf (summary for customers), customer_confirmation_template.docx (email template we will send after purge).

If you'd like, I can schedule a short call with engineering (Marcus/ Priyom) to walk the technical details.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-13T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: complete removal of model interaction data (prompts/outputs/logs)

Laura / Marcus,

A few technical notes to set expectations for the purge and evidence bundle. Quick bullets: 
- Storage locations: prompt/output pairs and most serialized caches live in eu-west object storage under bucket/batch prefixes: s3://rw-eu-west/glx/interaction_blobs/* and s3://rw-eu-west/glx/kvcache_snapshots/*. We will remove objects with the account tag GLX-7782.
- Caches: there are two cache types — ephemeral in-memory KV (no persisted content after instance teardown) and periodic persisted snapshots. We'll delete persisted snapshots and rotate any keys used by in-memory caches to reduce rehydration risk.
- Embeddings & indexes: embeddings are materialized into eu-west vector indexes. We'll delete embedding files and then asynchronously trigger index compaction to remove tombstones. Index compaction timing can add 24 hours.
- Logs: request/response logs that include full payloads are stored with PII flag; aggregated telemetry (token counts, latency histograms) are maintained separately. We'll remove PII-tagged logs and keep aggregated metrics (not reversible).
- Backup retention: we need to confirm whether you require deletion from cross-region backups. Standard backup TTL is 30 days; for this request we will enforce immediate removal from active storage and expedite retention overrides for applicable backups where feasible — full backup purges may require additional authorization due to replication windows.

Proposed operational timeline (dependent on verification):
Day 0: intake + signoff
Day 1: lock/quarantine and schedule purge job (start window)
Day 2: run purge job (object deletes + embeddings removal)
Day 3: index compaction + audit capture + deliver evidence bundle

Evidence we will supply: deletion_manifest.csv (object keys deleted), job_audit.log (immutable job trace), signed_deletion_receipt.pdf, and an execution timestamp range. We will provide a checksum of the manifest file and a signed hash.

Caveats: if any third-party index or export (customer-hosted mirrors) exist we will need their cooperation. Also, for Private/VPC customers the exact steps differ; since Globex is on Hosted EU plane this flow applies.

If Laura wants, I can draft the exact log query we will ship as part of the evidence package.

Thanks,
Priyom
Engineering, Data Platform
Redwood Inference

Emma,

Thanks — we have your written confirmation and authorization on file (received 2027-04-15 10:28 UTC) and have scheduled the EU purge job to run on 2027-04-17 starting at 02:00 UTC. Summary of what will be executed (and what will be retained):

To be removed (region-scoped, GLX-7782, eu-west):
- All prompt/output object blobs in s3://rw-eu-west/glx/interaction_blobs/ (range 2026-10-01 to 2027-04-15).
- Persisted KV cache snapshots and any serialized cache snapshots for GLX-7782.
- Materialized embeddings and index shards created by Redwood for search/retrieval tied to the deleted blobs.
- PII-flagged request/response logs containing content payloads.

Retained:
- Aggregated billing and usage counters (token totals, request counts) without content.
- System-level operational logs (non-content telemetry) needed for platform reliability.

Post-execution artifacts you will receive:
1) signed_deletion_receipt.pdf (attached after execution)
2) deletion_manifest.csv (list of deleted object keys; checksum included)
3) job_audit.log (immutable trace with job id RW-PGN-20270417-GLX7782)
4) short attestation letter confirming EU execution and that data was removed from active storage

Attachments included now for your reference: customer_confirmation_template.docx (sample confirmation email we will send immediately after job completes) and deletion_flow_checklist.pdf. After the job completes we will attach the signed_deletion_receipt-20270417.pdf and a secure link to the audit bundle.

If you'd like a live confirmation call right after the job, Marcus and Priyom can join. Otherwise we'll send the email confirmation and the bundle within 24 hours of completion.

Respectfully,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
